item.title: Capitol rioter who was pardoned by Trump gets a life sentence for molesting 2 children in Florida
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — A Florida handyman who was sentenced on Thursday to life in prison for molesting two children had been convicted of storming the Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, but was pardoned by President Donald Trump. item.title: Trump fires Homeland Security Secretary Noem after mounting criticism over her leadership
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump on Thursday fired his embattled Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, after mounting criticism over her leadership of the department, including the handling of the administration’s immigration crackdown and disaster response. item.title: Dee-Mack Chiefs girls basketball team cruises to a state final berth

item.title: Peoria honors non-profit with honorary street naming
item.description: The City of Peoria has dedicated a portion of Lake Avenue as "Junior League Way" to recognize the Junior League of Peoria's 90 years of service to the community.

item.title: Peoria man charged with aggravated sexual abuse of 13-year-old
item.description: Alfred Cahoon, 61, was arrested and charged with aggravated criminal sexual abuse after allegedly admitting to engaging in sexual acts with a 13-year-old girl in a video shared among students at a local school.

item.title: Woman injured after shooting on Stanley Street in Peoria
item.description: A woman was taken to a local hospital with minor injuries to her back after a shooting near South Stanley and West Humboldt Streets, and the Peoria Police Department is investigating the incident.

item.title: Officials urge storm preparedness ahead of possible severe weather in Central Illinois
item.description: Emergency officials in Central Illinois are reminding residents to prepare for severe weather by staying aware of the forecast, having multiple ways to receive warnings, and knowing the difference between a watch and a warning.

item.title: Chiddix Junior High principal to depart after school year ends
item.description: Dr. Mariana Nicasio, the principal of Chiddix Junior High School, announced her departure from the district at the end of the school year due to personal reasons, and will be relocating to California.

item.title: Man dies after being pinned at Rivian loading dock
item.description: A man died after being pinned between a semi and a loading dock at a Rivian warehouse in Normal, Illinois.
